prompt: A boxplot of the pages read by a book club last month has five-number summary $12, 18, 24, 31, 40$ (min, $Q_1$, median, $Q_3$, max). What percent of the members read between $18$ and $31$ pages?
hint: $18$ is $Q_1$ and $31$ is $Q_3$. Those are the edges of the BOX.

hints.text: $18$ is $Q_1$ and $31$ is $Q_3$. Those are the edges of the BOX.
The box always holds the middle half of the data, no matter how wide or narrow it looks.
From $Q_1$ to $Q_3$ is $50$ percent of the members.

explanation: $Q_1 = 18$ has about $25$ percent of the data below it; $Q_3 = 31$ has about $75$ percent below it.
Between them lies $75 - 25 = 50$ percent of the data.
So about $50$ percent of the members read between $18$ and $31$ pages.

alternativeExplanations.title: Four equal pieces
steps: The five-number summary cuts the data into four quarters: 12 to 18, 18 to 24, 24 to 31 and 31 to 40.
Each piece holds 25 percent of the members, even though the pieces are different widths.
